title: Sprint 1 — Getting Comfortable with Linux
description: Work entirely from the Linux terminal.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Install Ubuntu and Complete Initial Setup
tickets.description:
Task
Install Ubuntu Desktop or Server in a VM.
Update the OS.
Install VS Code, Git, Curl, Htop, Tree, Vim.
Configure the terminal with a custom prompt.
Deliverable
A working Linux machine ready for development.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Build Your Personal Workspace
tickets.description:
Task
Create a workspace like:
~/workspace
projects
scripts
downloads
backups
notes
Create everything only through terminal commands.
Add aliases for quickly navigating to these folders.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — Organize a Messy Downloads Folder
tickets.description:
Task
Given 100 mixed files,
Write commands/script that automatically moves
PDFs
Images
Videos
ZIP files
Documents
into separate folders.
No GUI allowed.

tickets.title: Ticket 4 — Recover Lost Files
tickets.description:
A project folder has hundreds of files.
Find
every Python file
every log file
every file larger than 50MB
every file modified today
Generate reports.

tickets.title: Ticket 5 — Create a Team Workspace
tickets.description:
Create
5 users
3 groups
Configure permissions so
Developers can edit code
Testers can only read
HR cannot access Engineering folder
Test using different users.

tickets.title: Ticket 6 — Build a Secure Shared Folder
tickets.description:
Requirements
Everyone can upload files
Nobody can delete someone else's files
Owner retains full control

tickets.title: Ticket 7 — Install Development Tools
tickets.description:
Install
Python
Node
Git
Docker
MySQL Client
Verify versions.
Create a shell script that installs everything automatically.

tickets.title: Ticket 8 — Deliver a Linux Development Machine
tickets.description: Package everything into documentation so another developer can reproduce your environment.
